"""Same-input sampled projection diagnostic, not a model qualification gate."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from hipengine.loading.gguf import GGUFReader, dequantize_gguf_data

r = GGUFReader('/models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf')
z = np.load('/tmp/ud-teacher-projection-one-token.npz')
x = z['attn_norm-0']
assert x.shape == (5120,) and np.isfinite(x).all()
u = x.view(np.uint32)
xb = ((u + np.uint32(0x7fff) + ((u >> 16) & 1)) & np.uint32(0xffff0000)).view(np.float32)
blocks = x.reshape(-1, 32)
d = np.max(np.abs(blocks), axis=1, keepdims=True) / np.float32(127)
scaled = np.divide(blocks, d, out=np.zeros_like(blocks), where=d != 0)
q = np.copysign(np.floor(np.abs(scaled) + np.float32(.5)), scaled)
xq = (q * d.astype(np.float16).astype(np.float32)).reshape(-1)
result = dict(diagnostic_only=True, promotion_qualified=False,
    scope='Same teacher F32 normalized input; 128 uniformly spaced output rows per layer0 projection.',
    limitation='Reconstructed Q8_1 activations approximate MMVQ; affine Q5_K sum correction and GPU reduction order are not emulated.',
    projections={})
for tensor, field in [('blk.0.attn_qkv.weight', 'linear_attn_qkv_mixed-0'), ('blk.0.attn_gate.weight', 'z-0')]:
    t = r.tensor_info(tensor)
    rows = np.linspace(0, t.shape[0] - 1, 128, dtype=np.int64)
    w = dequantize_gguf_data(np.ascontiguousarray(r.tensor_data(tensor)[rows]), t.ggml_type).astype(np.float64)
    teacher = z[field][rows].astype(np.float64)
    report = dict(quant=t.ggml_type_name, sampled_rows=rows.tolist(), paths={})
    for name, values in [('f32_input', x), ('bf16_input', xb), ('reconstructed_q8_1_input', xq)]:
        y = w @ values.astype(np.float64)
        delta = y - teacher
        report['paths'][name] = dict(rms_error=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(delta**2))), max_abs_error=float(np.max(np.abs(delta))), relative_rms_error=float(np.linalg.norm(delta)/np.linalg.norm(teacher)))
    result['projections'][tensor] = report
    print(tensor, json.dumps(report['paths']))
Path('/tmp/ud-teacher-projection-oracle.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+'\n')

"""Check raw Q5_K arithmetic on sampled teacher-input projections."""
import ctypes
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
ctypes.CDLL('libamdhip64.so')
from hipengine.loading.gguf import GGUFReader, dequantize_gguf_data
from hipengine.core.memory import malloc, free, copy_host_to_device, copy_device_to_host, host_array_ptr
from hipengine.kernels.hip_gfx1100.quant.gguf_k_gemv import build_gguf_k_gemv, gguf_q5_k_gemv_bf16_f32_out
r=GGUFReader('/models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf')
z=np.load('/tmp/ud-teacher-projection-one-token.npz')
u=z['attn_norm-0'].view(np.uint32)
x=((u+np.uint32(0x7fff)+((u>>16)&1))>>16).astype(np.uint16)
xf=(x.astype(np.uint32)<<16).view(np.float32).astype(np.float64)
library=build_gguf_k_gemv(load=True, compiler_version=Path('/tmp/ud-hipcc-version.txt').read_text())
reports={}
for name,field in [('blk.0.attn_qkv.weight','linear_attn_qkv_mixed-0'),('blk.0.attn_gate.weight','z-0')]:
 t=r.tensor_info(name); assert t.ggml_type_name=='Q5_K'
 rows=np.linspace(0,t.shape[0]-1,128,dtype=np.int64)
 raw=np.ascontiguousarray(r.tensor_data(name)[rows])
 oracle=dequantize_gguf_data(raw,t.ggml_type).astype(np.float64)@xf
 out=np.full(130,123,dtype=np.float32); buffers=[]
 try:
  for array in (x,raw,out):
   b=malloc(array.nbytes); buffers.append(b); copy_host_to_device(b,host_array_ptr(array),array.nbytes)
  gguf_q5_k_gemv_bf16_f32_out(buffers[0].ptr,buffers[1].ptr,buffers[2].ptr+4,1,5120,128,library=library)
  copy_device_to_host(host_array_ptr(out),buffers[2],out.nbytes)
  assert np.all(out[[0,-1]]==123) and np.isfinite(out).all()
  np.testing.assert_allclose(out[1:-1],oracle,rtol=2e-5,atol=2e-4)
  saved=out.copy()
  gguf_q5_k_gemv_bf16_f32_out(buffers[0].ptr,buffers[1].ptr,buffers[2].ptr+4,1,5120,128,library=library)
  copy_device_to_host(host_array_ptr(out),buffers[2],out.nbytes)
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(out.view('u4'),saved.view('u4'))
  reports[name]=dict(sampled_rows=rows.tolist(),max_abs_cpu_error=float(np.max(np.abs(out[1:-1]-oracle))),teacher_rms_error=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((out[1:-1]-z[field][rows])**2))),repeat_exact=True,canaries_pass=True)
 finally:
  for b in reversed(buffers): free(b)
print(json.dumps(reports,indent=2))
Path('/tmp/ud-projection-hip-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(reports,indent=2)+'\n')
